passage: Marco: Honestly the report was a mess and I had to redo half of it. | Marco: Next time just ask me first.
question: How do you reply?
option_0: Sorry it cost you time. Can we agree what you need before I start?

option_3: No problem! Really, no worries at all :)

passage: Me: I signed off on the vendor change on 3 March. | Hana: The director just asked who approved it. | Hana: I told her it was you. Was that right?
question: How do you answer?
option_0: I do not remember. Maybe it was Tom.
option_1: Yes, that was me. I can send the email trail now.
option_2: Why did you name me without asking?
option_3: Tell her it was a team decision.
explanation: Own the decision plainly and offer proof. Shifting blame or going vague damages trust.
